enableLifecycleEmails.title: Enable Lifecycle Email Delivery
enableLifecycleEmails.description: Send styled HTML emails for CSP milestone events (request submitted, broadcast complete, etc.). If disabled, in-app notifications continue to work.

cacheRefreshInterval.title: Cache Refresh Interval (seconds)
cacheRefreshInterval.description: How often user dashboard CSP feeds refresh to check for stale data. Recommended: 15-60 seconds.

enableVisibilityDiagnostics.title: Enable Admin Visibility Diagnostics
enableVisibilityDiagnostics.description: Allow admins to view hidden broadcast audit trail with reason classifications and auto-refresh on mutations.

diagnosticsSampleLimit.title: Hidden Broadcasts Sample Size
diagnosticsSampleLimit.description: Maximum number of hidden broadcasts to display in admin diagnostics table.

smtpFromAddress.title: Email From Address
smtpFromAddress.description: Sender address for lifecycle emails. Must be configured in admin settings.

enableAuditLogging.title: Enable Audit Logging
enableAuditLogging.description: Log all CSP lifecycle events and admin mutations to audit trail for compliance.

notificationRetentionDays.title: Notification Retention (days)
notificationRetentionDays.description: How long to retain CSP lifecycle notifications in user dashboard history.
